{{Quote|Lastly, we have a complaint from the Aar'aa regarding their order. Apparently, the MSE droids skittering underfoot are making them uncomfortably&hellip;hungry.|Rebaxan Columni executives product-testing the MSE-6, whose design was based on the pleeky|<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
A popular pet on the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Chad/Legends|Chad]], the '''pleeky''', also named the '''chak-chak''', was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] which was miniscule in stature. The pleeky's features inspired the design of [[Rebaxan Columni/Legends|Rebaxan Columni's]] [[MSE-series]] "[[Mouse/Legends|mouse]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]]," and despite the manufacturing executives' hope that customers would find the MSEs cute, many buyers found the machines discomforting. Faced with [[Currency/Legends|bankruptcy]] toward the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars']] end, the company sold all of its [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droids]] to the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:MSE-4.png|thumb|right|300px|Jumpy MSE droids, whose design owed to the pleeky.]]
The pleeky,<ref name="NEGTD" /> also known as the chak-chak, was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of diminutive [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] that lived on<ref name="FF" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]], which was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to<ref name="Chad" /> the rodent-descended<ref name="FF" /> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] species.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> The creature featured long fur that partly hid a deceptively strong pair of long [[Limb/Legends|arms]] that folded up. Coupled with the addition of four smaller legs beneath its furry body, the well-balanced pleeky could achieve incredible speeds, creating the visual illusion of a fur [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]], darting seemingly without means of propulsion.<ref name="FF" />

==History==
The Chadra-Fan&ndash;ran [[Rebaxan Columni/Legends|Rebaxan Columni's]] [[MSE-series]] "[[Mouse/Legends|mouse]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]]" design was inspired by the pleeky,<ref name="NEGTD" /> a popular pet on<ref name="FF" /> Chad.<ref name="Chad" /> While Rebaxan Columni wished that the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] market would consider the MSE cute,<ref name="NEGTD" /> many potential buyers from different cultures did not share the company's enthusiastic attitude regarding rodentia. Indeed, a majority of the [[Rat/Legends|rat]]-like [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6]] droids<ref name="FF" />&mdash;which had been manufactured in the billions after test runs of the [[MSE-4/Legends|MSE-4]] and [[MSE-5 General Purpose Droid|MSE-5]]<ref name="NEGTD" />&mdash;were left unbought,<ref name="FF" /> and most of the units that were sold were returned upon the buyers' realization that the machines resembled [[Disease/Legends|disease]]-carrying rodents that plagued the antiquated [[Boat/Legends|sailing ships]] of [[Time/Legends|times]] long gone. Similarly,<ref name="NEGTD" /> the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]]<ref name="PS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> [[Aar'aa]] customers complained that their skittering MSE-6s brought discomfort by triggering their [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] cravings.<ref name="NEGTD" />

Rebaxan Columni's mouse droid venture thus resulted in [[Currency/Legends|bankruptcy]] toward the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="NEGTD" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> although the newly established [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] acquired the company's remaining MSE-6s as ubiquitous [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] to service its expanding [[Imperial Navy/Legends|starfleet]].<ref name="FF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pleeky was introduced as "chak-chak" in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 19|nineteenth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine<ref name="FF" /> around [[May 8]], [[2002]].<ref name="FFdates">{{FFdates|19}}</ref> [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2006]] reference title ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' later provided the name "pleeky."<ref name="NEGTD" />
